premises.text: Rising compute demand is limited by server heat, and current data-center cooling is inadequate
premises.evidence_span: our demand for data is bigger than what technology can handle

premises.text: Two-phase liquid-to-gas cooling integrated in a drop-in server cools CPUs below ambient, accelerating compute and cutting energy use
premises.evidence_span: this can allow us to go below ambient

premises.text: Customers needing fast, reliable compute (e.g., banking, innovation, real-time data) adopt the cooled servers without changing data-center form factor
premises.evidence_span: You can insert it in any data center today, so you don't have to change a thing

value.text: Faster, more energy-efficient servers by cooling CPUs below ambient
value.evidence_span: world's fastest and most efficient server to accelerate your innovation

secondary_value.text: Cool down the planet one server at a time
secondary_value.evidence_span: cool down the planet one server at a time
